_meta.status: hypothesis — two approaches held in tension, designed to be deformed by the inference store
_meta.dichotomy: structure/function — orthogonal to the founding analog/digital tension
_meta.description: Two alternate approaches to the logos coordinate system held in the same file. Functional (event-level: what communication does) and structural (context-level: where communication occurs in social space). A model reading this should react to both simultaneously. The _relationship block names what is known and unknown about how they compose.
_meta.component: logos — combined structural and functional schema
sources: Logos Core Tree — synthesized in project (both)
_meta.llm: claude-sonnet-4-6 | 2026-05-20 | pillars/logos/logos_combined_v01.json | created — functional (logos_schema_v01) and structural (perplexity_suggested_v02) held in tension; _relationship block names overlap candidates and open questions

functional.description: Sparse coordinate system for individual communication acts at the local scale. Utterances do things — this schema describes what they do, how they are received, and whether cooperative maxims are honored.

act_type.description: What kind of action the communication performs.

values.directive: attempts to get someone to do something
values.commissive: commits the speaker to future action

transmission.description: How the communication moves through the social field.

values.broadcast: one-to-many, public, low fidelity to source
values.leak: restricted, few recipients, high emotional charge, unofficial
values.archive: past-to-future, preserved, institutional, resistant to revision

resonance.description: The emotional field the communication carries or creates.

authority.description: What power structure the communication draws on to be heard.

values.occult: hidden, known only within a restricted group

utility.description: What the communication is functionally for — its payload.

values.currency: value-tracking, social capital, ledger of obligation

cooperative.description: Whether Grice's cooperative maxims are honored or violated. Violations generate implicature — meaning beyond the words. The gap between said and meant is a tension signal.

maxims.quality: say what you believe to be true

social_field.description: Douglas grid/group axes describing the social constraint field.
social_field.grid: 0.0-1.0: degree to which behavior is constrained by explicit rules
social_field.group: 0.0-1.0: degree to which individual identity is defined by group membership

structural._level: context — where communication occurs in social space
structural.description: Geometric coordinate system for locating communication contexts in social space. Layers are coordinate points, not social labels. Axes are ordered from self to global scale.

monotonicity: archival transmission appears only at high scale
formal authority emerges at upper layers

known: functional describes event-level communication: what an utterance does
structural describes context-level social space: where communication occurs
these are not competing — they operate at different levels of analysis
both are needed for a complete logos coordinate
the structure/function dichotomy is orthogonal to the founding analog/digital tension — the product is a 2x2 space
unknown: how functional and structural compose into a single inference tag
whether the analog/digital axis cross-cuts both or maps differently onto each
whether tension score needs two independent axes (analog/digital AND structure/function)
which structural layer a given functional act_type is most likely to occur at
whether resonance (functional) and density (structural) are independent or correlated
overlap_candidates: authority: functional has 3 values (sovereign/tribal/occult), structural has 6-value scale (self→formal) — same axis at different resolutions?

transmission: functional has 3 values (broadcast/leak/archive), structural has 6 values (direct/leak/ritual/broadcast/archive/code) — 'leak' and 'broadcast' and 'archive' appear in both — structural may be a higher-resolution version of functional
generative_questions: Does a 'declaration' act_type (functional) only occur at 'institution' or 'global' structural layers?
Does 'illusion' resonance (functional) correlate with 'institutional' or 'durable' persistence (structural)?
Is the cooperative 'violated' status more likely at high structural scale (institution, global)?
Do the structural monotonicity constraints predict anything about functional resonance trajectories?

inference_tag.description: An inference may be tagged against functional dimensions, structural coordinates, or both. Partial tagging is valid — a model should tag what it can and leave the rest null.
